title: incremental-shadow-promote-with-stochastic-cohort-smoothing
author: Priya K. Raman
release_notes: Adds an opt-in 'incremental shadow promote' controller that gradually promotes shadow traffic to live with cohort smoothing and rollback credit accounting. Backwards compatible. Toggle via rollout.v1alpha2.policy.promoteStrategy=IncrementalShadowPromote.
description: Motivation: We observed that direct shadow-to-canary promotions cause stepwise metric volatility for sparse cohorts and stateful sessions. Small cohorts spike evaluation noise and trigger noisy rollbacks. This PR implements an opt-in 'Incremental Shadow Promote' strategy that incrementally converts shadowed traffic into promoted traffic by stochastic cohort smoothing and a credit-based rollforward/rollback policy. Design summary: 1) Cohort Smoothing: a lightweight sampler produces smoothed promotion increments per cohort using a configurable smoothing factor and jitter distribution to avoid synchronized bursts. 2) Promotion Credits: each cohort accrues 'promotion credits' from successful smoke checks (latency, error-rate, output-quality evals). Credits are consumed to increase promoted percentage; negative deltas trigger staged refunds and holdpoints. 3) Session Affinity Preservation: promotion decisions respect session affinity keys if provided; we ensure sticky sessions are not split mid-request by tagging candidate sessions and draining on safe commit. 4) Metric Alignment Gate: a multi-metric aggregator computes an aligned score across latency P95, error-rate, and eval-quality delta; the aligned score is compared to per-cohort dynamic thresholds before any credit spend. 5) Replay-safe Rollback: when a rollback is triggered, the controller attempts a partial rewind using shadow capture snapshots and a limited replay to surface representative failures for debugging; this is gated by a replay budget. Implementation notes: - New controller: service/rollout/incremental_promote_controller.go implements the reconciliation loop, credit accounting, and cohort state machine. - Sampling lib: internal/rollout/sampler.go contains the stochastic smoothing sampler with deterministic seeding for test determinism. - Metric adapter: observability/adapter/promote_metrics.go adds the aligned score computation and exposes debug traces for the console. - Session draining helpers: infra/session/drain.go with small helpers used by the controller to mark and drain affected sessions. - Config: api/rollout/v1alpha2/policy.proto extended with PromoteStrategy enum and strategy params (smoothing_factor, replay_budget, credit_window). Tests and validation: - Unit tests for sampler and credit accounting in service/rollout/*_test.go. - Integration smoke tests in examples/rollout/smoke that run a 3-cohort scenario with synthetic metrics. - e2e test harness addition: perf-canary/test/incremental_promote_e2e.yaml covering a simulated rollback and replay. Backwards compatibility and opt-in: The new PromoteStrategy is behind a feature flag and defaults to the existing promote behavior. No customer-facing API changes unless customers opt into the new strategy. Rollout plan: 1) Merge to main behind feature flag. 2) Deploy controller to staging and run e2e harness; opt-in a synthetic customer via console. 3) Run 2 week A/B experiment comparing 'IncrementalShadowPromote' to the baseline. 4) If results are stable, enable as GA with telemetry dashboard and rollout recipe. Operational considerations: - Telemetry: added per-cohort credit burn rate and replay budget metrics. - Alerts: new alert 'promote-credit-depletion' to avoid stalled promotions. - Cost: replay budget is intentionally tiny for GA to limit cost, adjustable per-customer. Related work: Builds on the shadow-capture and cohort-anchoring projects (see ENG-1198 and ENG-1740). This PR is intentionally focused on the controller and safety gates; it does not change kernel-level serving runtime or KV cache logic. Security and compliance: replay snapshots are sanitized and honor PII redaction hooks before any storage. Code review highlights: - Deterministic tester seed ensures reproducible test failures. - Credit ledger persisted as annotations on the rollout resource to survive controller restarts. - Metrics are tagged with cohort_id and promote_strategy for downstream dashboards. Known limitations: - Very large numbers of tiny cohorts may increase controller memory; we cap cohort caching and evict based on LRU with a configurable retention window. - Current replay uses a sampled subset of requests; it is not a full fidelity replay system.

Unit and integration tests for sampler and ledger

Docs: rollout strategy doc and console feature flag text
review_comments: Luca Martinez: Nice approach. Question: how sensitive is aligned score to highly skewed latency distributions? Could we add a robust mean or trimmed mean?
Priya: Good point. I added a trimmed-mean option and made it configurable (smoothing config). Default remains median-based to be robust to tail noise.
Anika Chen: Need to ensure credit ledger writes are idempotent in case of controller flapping.
Priya: Ledger writes are implemented as compare-and-swap on rollout annotations; added tests to simulate controller restart races.
Samir Patel: Add an opt-out for replay snapshots for customers in high compliance orgs.
Priya: Added a config flag 'replay_snapshot_allowed' and circuit-breaker check before any snapshot is taken.
